title: not + any no none
summary: Три способа отрицания: not + any, no + существительное и none (отдельное слово); следим, чтобы отрицание было одно.
ru:
## Три способа сказать «нет, ничего нет»
1. **not + any**: *There aren't any cars.*
2. **no + существительное**: *There are no cars.*
3. **none** — отдельное слово-ответ: *How many cars? — None.*

## not + any
> We haven't got **any** money. — У нас нет денег.
> I don't want **any** coffee. — Я не хочу кофе.

## no + существительное
**no** значит то же, что **not any** (или **not a**). Часто с **have (got)** и **there is / there are**.
> We've got **no** money. = We haven't got any money.
> There is **no** garden. = There isn't a garden.
> There are **no** buses today. = There aren't any buses today.
Помните: в английском предложении **одно отрицание**.
- ~~We haven't got no money.~~ → We have**n't** got **any** money. / We've got **no** money.

## none — без существительного
Это ответ на **How much?** / **How many?**:
> — How much money have you got? — **None.** — Сколько у тебя денег? — Нисколько.
> — Were there any problems? — No, **none**. — Проблемы были? — Нет, никаких.

## none и no-one
- **none** — ответ на *How much / How many* (вещи и люди в количестве).
- **no-one / nobody** — ответ на *Who?*:
> — Who did you meet? — **No-one.**

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I don't have no time.~~ → I don't have **any** time. / I have **no** time.
- ~~There are none people.~~ → There are **no** people.
- ~~How many books have you got? — No.~~ → **None.**
en:
## Three ways to say there is nothing
1. **not + any**: *There aren't any cars.*
2. **no + noun**: *There are no cars.*
3. **none** (alone): *How many cars? — None.*

## not + any
> We haven't got **any** money.
> I don't want **any** coffee.

## no + noun
**no** = **not any** / **not a**. We often use it after **have (got)** and **there is / there are**.
> We've got **no** money. = We haven't got any money.
> There is **no** garden. = There isn't a garden.
In English one negative is enough:
- ~~We haven't got no money.~~ → We haven't got **any** money. / We've got **no** money.

## none — without a noun
It answers **How much?** and **How many?**
> — How much money have you got? — **None.**
> — Were there any problems? — No, **none**.

## none and no-one
- **none** answers *How much / How many*.
- **no-one / nobody** answers *Who?*: — Who did you meet? — **No-one.**

## Common mistakes
- ~~I don't have no time.~~ → I don't have **any** time. / I have **no** time.
- ~~There are none people.~~ → There are **no** people.
structure:
## Схема
| Способ | Пример | Значение |
|---|---|---|
| not + any | There **isn't any** sugar. | сахара нет |
| no + noun | There is **no** sugar. | сахара нет |
| none | — How much sugar? — **None.** | нисколько |

## Формулы
> отрицательный глагол + **any** = положительный глагол + **no**
> They haven't got **any** children. = They've got **no** children.

## Что нельзя
> ~~not + no~~ (двойное отрицание): *I don't have no car* — ошибка.
> ~~none + существительное~~: *none friends* — ошибка → **no friends**.
> **none of** + the / my / these (см. дальше): *none of my friends*
